name: Working Capital Advance
summary: Murabaha working-capital facility for producers and traders — 6 to 36 months.
description: Finance inventory purchases and operating cycle gaps. Murabaha-based: the bank purchases goods and resells them to you at cost plus an agreed profit margin, payable in monthly installments. Decisions typically within 5 working days after platform verification.
financingLimitText: Financing ranges from 100,000 to 75 million Yemeni Rials.
targetAudience: Registered traders, processors and distributors with active commercial operations
termsNote: Final terms are agreed with the bank; the annual Murabaha rate will not exceed 24%, and the repayment period will not be less than 6 months.

name: Supplier Qualification Program
summary: Al-Amal supplier accreditation — qualified suppliers unlock RFQ participation with the bank.
description: Become an approved supplier to Al-Amal Bank and its institutional clients. Accredited companies are listed as qualified vendors, receive and respond to RFQs in the marketplace, and get auto-passed on financing requirements already covered by the accreditation.
targetAudience: Suppliers and vendors seeking institutional RFQ participation
termsNote: The qualification fee is invoiced externally and covers the 12-month accreditation period.

name: Invoice Financing
summary: Advance on confirmed invoices — up to 80% of face value, 30–180 days.
description: Bridge the gap between delivering an order and getting paid. Present confirmed marketplace invoices; Al-Kuraimi advances up to 80% of the invoice value with settlement from the buyer payment.

name: Vendor Approval Program
summary: Al-Kuraimi vendor accreditation for marketplace RFQ participation.
description: Qualification program for vendors seeking RFQ participation with Al-Kuraimi and its partner institutions. Live accreditation auto-passes financing requirements marked for it.
targetAudience: Product vendors seeking marketplace approval and financing eligibility
termsNote: The approval fee is invoiced externally and covers the 12-month vendor accreditation period.

name: Solar Equipment Lease-to-Own
summary: Lease solar equipment with progressive ownership — up to 36 months.
description: A lease-to-own facility for solar water pumps, panels and storage. Monthly payments build ownership; title transfers on final installment. Targets agricultural cooperatives and SMEs in Aden, Taiz and Hodeidah.
financingLimitText: Financing ranges from 50,000 to 50 million Yemeni Rials.
targetAudience:
Owners of small and micro-enterprises/projects
Employees of government, private, and mixed-sector entities
termsNote: Terms can be agreed upon with the bank or institution; note that the annual Murabaha rate will not exceed 30%, and the loan repayment period will not be less than 6 months.

name: Home Solar Installment Plan
summary: Murabaha installments for household solar systems — 80,000 to 2.5M YER over 6–36 months.
description: Bring reliable power home. Al-Amal finances complete residential solar systems — panels, battery, inverter and installation — selected from Vendora’s engineer-reviewed catalog. A murabaha contract fixes the total price at signing; monthly installments are flat and known. Free survey visit before approval, and the system is insured for the entire tenor.
financingLimitText: Financing ranges from 80,000 to 2.5 million Yemeni Rials.
targetAudience: Households and individuals installing residential solar systems
termsNote: Final terms are agreed with the bank; the annual Murabaha rate will not exceed 16%, and the repayment period will not be less than 6 months.

name: Agriculture Equipment Financing
summary: Sharia-compliant financing for solar pumps and farm equipment — 100k to 20M YER, up to 60 months.
description: Al-Kuraimi finances the tools that make farms productive: solar pumping systems, drip irrigation, cold storage and processing equipment. Repayment follows the crop calendar — grace periods align with planting, and balloon installments land after harvest. Decisions in 5 working days, with technical vetting from Vendora’s engineering team.
financingLimitText: Financing ranges from 100,000 to 20 million Yemeni Rials.
targetAudience: Farmers, cooperatives and agri-businesses across covered governorates
termsNote: Final terms are agreed with the institution; the annual Murabaha rate will not exceed 14%, and the repayment period will not be less than 6 months.

name: Micro Business Growth Facility
summary: Small-ticket working capital for workshops and shops — 30k to 3M YER, fast decisions.
description: The growth facility behind thousands of Yemeni micro businesses: a top-up friendly murabaha line for tools, stock and equipment. Apply through Vendora in under 10 minutes; approval decisions land in 48 hours for returning customers. Group guarantees accepted where individual collateral is not available.
financingLimitText: Financing ranges from 30,000 to 3 million Yemeni Rials.
targetAudience: Owners of micro-enterprises and home-based businesses
termsNote: Final terms are agreed with the institution; the annual Murabaha rate will not exceed 22%, and the repayment period will not be less than 4 months.

name: SME Solar Package
summary: Complete solar power systems for SMEs on fixed-rate installments — 500k to 40M YER.
description: A turnkey package for small and medium enterprises: system design, equipment, installation and financing in one contract. Tihama’s engineering partner sizes the system to your load profile; repayments are fixed annual-rate installments over up to 60 months. Diesel replacement analysis included — most customers cut energy cost by 60% or more.
financingLimitText: Financing ranges from 500,000 to 40 million Yemeni Rials.
targetAudience: Small and medium enterprises upgrading or installing commercial solar power
termsNote: Final terms are agreed with the institution; the fixed annual rate will not exceed 17%, and the repayment period will not be less than 12 months.
